variants.headline: {{city}} comes under direct rule
body: The same flag flies over {{city}}, but the days of puppet rule are over. The city now falls under the direct government of {{owner}}.

variants.headline: Settlers ready as {{town}} grows smaller
body: A party of settlers is ready in {{town}}. There are fewer people to feed in the city now, and more food still comes in than goes on the table.

variants.headline: Settlers ready, spirits low in {{town}}
body: {{town}} has raised a party of settlers. There are fewer people now and food to spare, but spirits in the city are low.
What will the prospect of a new town do for the people who must make a life in this one?

variants.headline: Good cheer in {{town}} as settlers prepare to go
body: {{town}} has raised a party of settlers. There are fewer places to set for supper these days, with food to spare.
A town in good spirits can afford to wish its settlers well.

variants.headline: A new town on the doorstep of {{ours}}
body: A town founded by {{player}} brings the frontier close to {{ours}}. For the two settlements, a field that looks like room to grow from one side may look like a neighbor's claim from the other.

variants.headline: A rival town rises close to home
body: A town founded by {{player}} puts a rival close to one of our own settlements. There is little ground between the two sites to grow into.

variants.headline: Food runs short in damaged {{town}}
body: {{town}} has damage to mend in the midst of war. Its more immediate worry is supper: the city is eating into its reserves, and at this rate the stores will soon be bare.

variants.headline: {{key}} gains the majority in {{count}} cities near ours
body: The religious map close to home has taken on a new color. In {{count}} neighboring cities, {{key}} has gained a majority.
